_doc: Every candidate /upstream-sync measured, shipped or not. Search it before proposing: sync.py tried WORD.

tried.what: read curly apostrophes as straight ones before the CHECKS regexes
tried.result: checklist AUC blog gpt 0.830->0.854, opus 0.753->0.746 (one human post now trips A4), sonnet 0.997->0.996; fiction gpt 0.911->0.922
tried.reason: pooled AUC up, no new FAIL on humans

tried.what: surprisingly
tried.result: B1 FAIL gpt 43%->50%, lexicon AUC sonnet 0.857->0.861, humans 0%
tried.reason: passed per-entry rule (<=4% human, >=10% AI train)

tried.what: the real \w+ (?:is|isn't|was)
tried.result: A3 on sonnet 0%->14%, T1 sonnet 93%->100%, humans unchanged

tried.what: 'The hardest part wasn't X. It was Y.' with any subject
tried.measured: evaluate.py + eval/e2e dev (20 titles) and test (18), 2 rewrites per title, 2 Opus + 1 GPT judges
tried.result: checklist AUC 0.860->0.873 (passes detection); e2e Opus dev 32.0->34.0 worse 12/20 p=0.28, test 26.7->26.1 p=0.36
tried.reason: same family as A1c: catches AI but rewrites get worse
tried.retry_if: a different way to steer rewrites away from it, with its own e2e

tried.what: plain 'not X, but Y'
tried.retry_if: a guard that drops plain concessions ('isn't expensive, but')

tried.what: is not a X, but a Y
'No X, no Y, no Z' and 'didn't X, didn't Y'
tried.result: blog opus 0.746->0.756 (1 text); fiction: one held-out human story trips A1, opus 0.571->0.562
tried.reason: fiction humans use it, blog gain is one text

tried.what: count 'isn't X, it's Y' only with a second frame within 2 sentences
tried.result: AUC down in blog (0.860->0.857) and fiction (0.805->0.789)

tried.what: numbers + mid-sentence proper nouns + links per 1k words

tried.what: over-used content bigrams/trigrams against human train
tried.result: blog AI-side AUC up, fiction 0.983->0.977, es 0.829->0.818, human overshot up

bold_1k, para_cv_std, para_punct_cv, para_sent_cv, fw_trigram_entropy

tried.measured: 19 dev rewrites with sample.md, base snapshot
